rows.label: Tax status: Guam Territorial Income Tax mirrors the US code; US FICA applies, FUTA does not
rows.value: Guam has its own income tax system, the Guam Territorial Income Tax, which mirrors the US Internal Revenue Code with the same laws and rates and is administered by the Guam Department of Revenue and Taxation; bona fide residents file one return, with Guam. US federal social security and Medicare (FICA, self-employment tax) apply; the federal unemployment tax (FUTA) does not. Guam levies its own business privilege tax (in place of a sales tax), excise and real property taxes.
